proposed_widenings.name: random_table_outcome_subgraph
proposed_widenings.justification: Random-table outcomes currently accept only EffectAtom bundles. This item needs some rows to resolve as full spell casts, save-gated timed effects, or creature-spawn procedures rather than immediate effect atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “Roll 1d10 to determine the spell … Darkness; Faerie Fire; Fireball; Slow; Stinking Cloud.”

proposed_widenings.name: apply_obscurement
proposed_widenings.justification: Two deterministic rows create temporary Lightly Obscured or Heavily Obscured areas. No existing effect atom models obscured-area state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “During that time, the area of effect is Lightly Obscured.” / “during which time the area of effect is Heavily Obscured.”

proposed_widenings.name: proximity_target_selection
proposed_widenings.justification: Several rows target the creature closest or nearest to the chosen point of origin. Current attachments support chosen targets and areas, but not deterministic nearest-subject selection.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “The creature closest to the chosen point of origin is enlarged …”
